title: Beyond Accuracy: How Quantization Affects Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.02368v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agents are increasingly used for coding tasks, but the inference cost of large language models (LLMs) limits where they can run. Quantization reduces model size, but its effects on coding agents that execute and revise programs remain underexplored. We compare BF16 with 4-bit AWQ and GPTQ for Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct (7B, 14B, and 32B) and Devstral-Small-2507 (24B) on OJBench coding problems across three seeds. We detect no statistically significant accuracy loss for any of the coding agents. However, final accuracy can conceal substantial behavioral changes: AWQ reduces Qwen-7B one-shot solves from 17 to 0 while increasing loop-based solves from 10 to 25. All Qwen-32B successes involve tool use, whereas Devstral rarely makes a valid executor call. Failure profiles also differ: Qwen-32B produces far more compilation errors than the smaller Qwen models, rising slightly under quantization, while Devstral's failures shift significantly from r

translated_title: 超越准确率：量化如何影响编程智能体
translated_abstract: 智能体在编程任务中的应用日益增多，但大型语言模型（LLM）的推理成本限制了它们的部署范围。量化可以减小模型体积，但其对执行和修改程序的编程智能体的影响仍缺乏充分研究。我们在OJBench编程问题上，使用三个随机种子，比较了BF16与4-bit AWQ和GPTQ两种量化方法在Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct（7B、14B和32B）和Devstral-Small-2507（24B）上的表现。我们没有检测到任何编程智能体存在统计上显著的准确率损失。然而，最终准确率可能掩盖实质性的行为变化：AWQ使Qwen-7B的一次性解题数从17降至0，同时使基于循环的解题数从10增至25。Qwen-32B的所有成功案例都涉及工具使用，而Devstral很少进行有效的执行器调用。失败特征也有所不同：Qwen-32B比更小的Qwen模型产生多得多的编译错误，且在量化下略有上升，而Devstral的失败模式则显著地从……
tldr: 量化虽然不会显著降低编程智能体的最终准确率，但会实质性地改变其解题行为和失败模式，表明仅凭准确率不足以评估量化对编程智能体的影响。
en_tdlr: Quantization does not significantly reduce coding agents' final accuracy, but it substantially alters their problem-solving behaviors and failure profiles, showing that accuracy alone is insufficient for evaluating quantization's impact on coding agents.
